SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
CAPE MAY COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26000276
DOCKET NO. F-012295-25
PLAINTIFF – U.S. BANK TRUST NATIONAL ASSOCIATION, NOT IN ITS INDIVIDUAL CAPACITY BUT SOLELY AS OWNER TRUSTEE FOR RCF 2 ACQUISITION TRUST
DEFENDANTS- MARIA ROWELL, ET AL
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 14th DAY OF October 2026
At 1:00 o'clock in the afternoon at the old Courthouse building located at 9 N Main Street (Route 9), in Cape May Court House, New Jersey to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the BOROUGH OF WOODBINE of Woodbine, County of Cape May and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 2, BLOCK 4
APPROX. DIMENSIONS: 150 X 157
NEAREST CROSS STREET: CLAY STREET
OCCUPANCY STATUS IS UNKNOWN
UPSET PRICE: $188,901.77
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS: 622 GRANT Avenue Woodbine, NJ 08270
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Cape May County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: *Subject to subsequent taxes, water and sewer plus interest through date of payoff.
SALE IS SUBJECT TO THE RIGHT OF REDEMPTION OF THE FEDERAL GOVERNMENT
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Cape May County Sheriff Office. Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon. If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any. The approximate amount due on this execution is $170,108.55 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Robert A. Nolan, SHERIFF
DATED: July 24, 2026
Parker McCay, P.A.
P.O. Box 5054
9000 Midlantic Drive, Suite 300
Mt. Laurel, NJ 08054
856-596-8900
